name: Buy Mescaline (Peyote) Online
description:
Buy Mescaline (Peyote) Online

Buy Mescaline (Peyote) Online, 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine is a chemical compound. Certain cacti, such as the Peyote, Peruvian Torch, and San Pedro cacti, naturally contain it. Certain species of the Fabaceae (bean) family, such as Acacia berlandieri, also contain trace levels of it.

The substance may result in hallucinations.

Schedule I drugs have a high potential for abuse, no currently accepted medical use in treatment in the United States, and a lack of accepted safety for use under medical supervision.

visual hallucinations and radically altered states of consciousness (psychedelic experience)

open and closed eye visualizations and euphoria

Slowed passage of time and laughter

A mixing of senses (synesthesia, such as “seeing a sound” or “hearing colors”)
